name: gemmLnc term AF4
equation: dW = D x sL x (n / t_op) x 1e-12 x (c1 x dup + c2 x R4) [W over idle]; R4 = Lres x beyond + (1 - Lres) x a3 x (14 qA_b + 12 qBF)

features.dup: 26 at rgm136 gemmLnc, 0 at every cooperative loop
features.beyond: 14 (1 - qA_L2) + 12 (1 - qB_L2), the map Q = (Q0 + Q1) / 2 of MM1-v3.2 at its all-data constants
features.m: 1 if 2 KB sa + KB sb > x1 (37.334 MB, MM1-v3.2 time theta x1) else 0
features.a3: 1 if NB = 1 or m = 1; else (1 - phi) if NB = 2; else 0
features.Lres: 1 if MM1's footprint(MB, NB, KB, mask) <= x1 else 0
features.D, sL, n, t_op: F3's: D = 1 + 0.0048 (die - 50 C), sL = 1 + xi (s_V - 1) at MM1-v3.2's xi, n minions, t_op the op time
